title: Shifting of Powerhouse to Existing ALK Quarter at Manakodam Lighthouse
summary: Notice inviting quotations to dismantle, shift, reinstall and commission the 7.5 kVA DG set, 5 kW solar plant and power panels from the powerhouse to an existing ALK quarter (temporary powerhouse) at Manakkodam Lighthouse, Alleppey district.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Manakkodam Lighthouse, P.O. Andhakaranazhi, Pattanakkadu, Alleppey (Dist)
sites.work: Shifting of powerhouse equipment (DG set, solar plant, panels) to existing ALK quarter with earthing, cabling and DG shed

scope.item: Earthing with G.I. earth plate 600x600x6 mm with masonry enclosure, watering pipe, charcoal/salt (for DG set, lightning conductor for solar panel and LT panel)
Supplying and laying 25x5 mm G.I strip 0.50 m below ground as strip earth electrode (4 earths, 15 m each)
Provision of SMC junction boxes (Sintex make) and termination of cables at first landing of tower and at temporary power house
Dismantling of 7.5kVA DG set, EAMF panel, voltage stabilizer and all electrical/electronic switchgear and wiring
Shifting of 7.5kVA DG set, EAMF panel, voltage stabilizer and switchgear to ALK Quarter (rain water tank slab to be DG foundation after demolition of tank)
Installation of 7.5kVA single phase DG set, EAMF panel, voltage stabilizer, LT panel and switchgear incl. wiring and terminations in temporary power house
Fabrication and fixing of DG shed shelter with GI sheet, 3m x 3m, square tube truss
Dismantling of 5kW solar panels including GI stand and wirings
Shifting of 5kW solar panels including stand and wirings to temporary store
Installation of 5kW solar panels including GI stand on concrete base on top of temporary powerhouse
Earthwork excavation and 1:2:4 concrete foundation with post pipe for ladder type cable supporting pole
Fabrication of ladder type cable supporting pole with 3 inch GI medium class pipe, 10 m height
Temporary meter shifting and temporary connection charges to KSEB with switchgears from pump house 3Ph feeder
Supply of 4C x 6 sqmm aluminium XLPE PVC sheathed unarmoured cable, 650/1100V, IS 7098 (Part 1)
Labour charges for overhead laying of flexible aluminium cable incl. termination and GI stay wire
Miscellaneous items (screws, bolts, nuts, washers, drill bits, cable ties, bends, tees, cable glands, PVC junction boxes etc.)

money.notes: Refundable EMD by DD/FDR in original in favour of Director, Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin; NSIC/MSME registered firms exempted. Rates to show basic cost and taxes separately; no escalation. 100% payment within 30 days of satisfactory completion. L1 on consolidated total of schedule.

period.completion: 30 days from the date of work order
period.bid_validity: 45 days from the date of opening of quotations
period.warranty: Warranty for each item to be specified by bidder

eligibility: EMD in original or NSIC/MSME registration certificate
Work experience of equivalent/similar electrical works of NIQ value or higher (supply orders/work completion)
Last 3 years income tax returns, PAN card, GST registration certificate
specs: 7.5 kVA single phase DG set with EAMF panel, voltage stabilizer, LT panel
4C x 6 sqmm XLPE aluminium cable to IS 7098 (Part 1) 1988; GI plate and strip earthing
